cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - Dispenser
cc:Work.dc:description:
Dispenser for stackable (flat) items of same size
Set *bottomheight* to 0 for a wall mounting variant. Please add mounting holes yourself.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes Dispenser --x 90 --y 70 --h 120 --viewingwidth 0.5 --bottomheight 20 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes Dispenser --x --y --h --viewingwidth --bottomheight --reference
